title: Very cute but did not last long
text:
Very cute but did not last long. I have had a no name convection (fan) infrared (familiar glowing metal tube things) in big glass bowl for awhile and loved it to death. The review is here somewhere on Amazon - though I got it at a popular online auction site and was obviously refurb to boot. Cut to the chase.

My happy oven was making more noise than I could tolerate lately. It was never quiet but was getting REALLY annoying. Also, the heat shield was nearly impossible to clean and getting on my Felix Unger uber-clean nerves. So I order this one up because A. IT IS RED. My kitchen is RED and I am a sucker for all appliances of the RED variety. B. It is HALOGEN and that is supposed to be better somehow, though not exactly sure WHY. C. It was Fagor and I have had very good experiences with them. I purchased accessories for my no name from them and they fit and were priced right and were shipped fast and their customer service was good. So I had also purchased a pressure cooker with likewise positive dealings with them.

Anyhow. This thing is CUTE. I mean it is like a cute little red bug in the corner of my kitchenette from hell. But A: the handle assembly is a tempremental and delicate beast. B. Although it is supposedly less watts than my no name it makes the lights in the kitchen dim when it is on. C: it does not cook as fast or as evenly as my no name infrared convection in a glass bowl.

I have been going back to my good old no name because I want even cooking, I don't want to blow the circuit breakers and it is faster.

Don't believe the hype about halogen (as in headlights). Like in headlights, I bet you can't touch them and sooner or later any grease that gets near them will kill it. I think that may be why this fan is so low powered, to reduce the risk of anything getting near the halogen bulb. I do have to admit it is nice that this thing has a nonstick coated heat shield. Much easier to maintain then the SS or aluminum one on my no name.

I would have to say if I could paint my no name RED I would stick with it.

UPDATE - I gave this some light usage over the holidays to supplement big ol' ugly no name which was sounding sadder and sadder. Unfortunately, this little red bug started making a worse noise. An awful screech, if i picked up the top and put it back on sometimes it would go away or it would go away after a few minutes. Obviously something in the motor. It became a constant noise and I have stopped using it altogether. I say it was used less than 20 times in six months. I did not get an extended warranty and don't know how long mfr warranty is. I have other Fagor items and have had good luck with their customer service. I am going to contact them and see if there is anything they are willing to do for me.

UPDATE - I emailed Fagor customer service a week ago. NO response. Well, so much for my consumer loyalty to Fagor. Just for this I will not buy a new Fagor Pressure Cooker when my current one goes I will buy Kuhn Rikon. I will use the cute red stand that came with the Fagor for some other brand of halogen oven.
